name: CHORUS705
description: "The Chorus series small bookshelf speaker system.A 14 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.These units use poly-glass diaphragms, which have been used only in high-end models. The surface of cellulose fiber cone with excellent resolution is coated with hollow fine particles of extremely hard silica glass resin with a special adhesive. The combination of cellulose with high internal loss and light weight and a highly synthetic silica glass layer enables smoother and more accurate sound wave propagation.Butyl edge is used for the edge part.A newly designed 2.6 cm inverted dome type tweeter called TPC is installed in the high range.In this TPC, the voice coil is rigidly fixed to the center of the dome to improve energy propagation while maintaining mechanical coupling between moving parts. In addition, the diaphragm is made of titanium monoblock and is damped with 5 Ï‰ m thick polymer. In particular, linearity in the 15 kHz to 22 kHz band is taken into consideration. In addition, a foam ring is installed between the MAG top of the net plate and face plate to eliminate unnecessary vibration.A phase plug is installed on the front of the unit to make sound wave diffusion uniform.The enclosure is designed with a bass-reflex port called a laminar flow.The front baffle is designed with a dark gray finish of highly rigid MDF material combined with a cherry finish cabinet.It is compatible with the Chorus series common speaker stand sold separately."

name: DAL-3-1S
description: "This speaker system uses a unique structure called the Decoupled Anti-resonant Line.A 12.7 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This unit uses a unique Neoflex resin for its diaphragm and is driven by a magnetic circuit consisting of a 25 mm dual voice coil with Nomex Former operating in parallel and a 100 mm diameter magnet.A 2.5 cm inverted dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses an inverted dome type titanium diaphragm with a 7 Ï‰ - thick coating of TIOXID, a titanium dioxide developed by JM Lab. This improves the allowable input and ensures smooth propagation of surface waves in concentric circles.There is also a diffuser in the front to compensate for directivity and sound radiation.The enclosure has a bass-reflex structure that employs a unique methodology called DAL (Decoupled Anti-resonant Line).The DAL 3.1s employs a 20.6 liter enclosure with a 19 mm thick rigid MDF material, the upper third of which is the cavity behind the woofer. This cavity is followed by a unique folded Super Tuned Bus Load, which is approximately 1.8m long and runs to the port on the lower back of the cabinet. It is tuned to provide a rich, phase-free low-frequency response without the use of sound absorbing materials.By filling the bottom of the cabinet with sand, low-frequency resonance is suppressed and overall rigidity is increased.The input terminal is bi-wired.Cleats are included."

name: UTOPIA
description: "This is a floor-type speaker system that uses our unique MVF technology F technology.Polykevlar is used for the diaphragm of all units.Poly-Kevlar fibers are assembled into two sheets of Kevlar fibers. They are sandwiched between fine hollow resin particles called microspheres, thereby achieving the opposite properties of light weight, rigidity, and moderate internal loss.In addition, the same material is used for all units to unify the sound quality.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The new Mechanical Vibration Free (MVF) technology has been introduced into the Woofer unit. In this technology, another magnetic circuit is installed on the back side of the magnetic circuit of the unit. By exciting this circuit, the mass in the opposite direction is created. This completely cancels the reaction which occurs in the back side when the unit vibrates. By maintaining the mechanical balance, the stress on the frame and cabinet is suppressed, and the vibration factor which affects by the strain is eliminated.Two 12 cm cone type skokers are mounted in the middle area.This unit is equipped with a diffuser in the center to equalize the radiated sound wave.A 2.8 cm inverted dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.High-efficiency design by dual voice coil is adopted, and crossover frequency is set to low band by excellent frequency characteristics.The rear panel is equipped with a network circuit so that the inside can be seen.The network elements include large polypropylene capacitors, self-inductive low-resistance air-core coils, wiring materials, connectors, and other parts carefully selected according to our own standards.The unit layout is arranged in such a way that the tweeter is sandwiched between two skorkers from the top and bottom. The quasi-coaxial configuration is designed to achieve point sound recording. In addition, slits are provided on the baffle surface of this quasi-coaxial configuration to prevent sound wave diffraction and suppress the disturbance of characteristics.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system. This enclosure is designed with vibration control as a theme. It has been thoroughly studied what vibration mode the material has and how vibration from the unit propagates from the frame to the cabinet when the unit is mounted."
